source: Transport for London open cycle-hire trip files
station_selection: Top 20 start stations by departure count during 2026-04-01 through 2026-04-07 inclusive; tie by station ID. Frozen before inspecting demand or forecasts.
quality: Validate archive coverage and unique journey IDs; count recorded departures per hour, including zero counts. Require every complete local calendar day in history to have a departure (partial boundary days are not tested) and positive history mean. Retain zero target hours; no loss filtering. Incomplete source coverage excludes cases.
interpretation: Observed completed cycle-hire departures, not unconstrained latent demand. Simulated hourly dispatch/service capacity; no inventory or rebalancing dynamics. Costs and ramps are simulated, not TfL operational economics.
